next_step.title: Land Palo Verde's and Cypress's new records, then Berkeley City's Multimedia Arts and Hartnell by its site
next_step.text: Load and reread Palo Verde's 66 records from its new 2026-2027 catalog and Cypress's 18 new ones, then one display build; read Berkeley City's free capture and make the curriQunet reader read each entry's child pages; teach the Coursedog site reader the tab Hartnell's catalog names.

calls.title: The second reader waits on a new xAI subscription
calls.text: Sam, 2026-10-20 about 16:30 UTC: the API is paid for separately from the Grok subscription, and the account is moving to the RCCD district credit card. When the key exists: Sam sets XAI_API_KEY and XAI_MODEL as Edge Function secrets on the Work Plan project, a session deploys program-requirements-extract with cpl-chat-deploy.yml, then runs second-reader.yml for Canada College.
calls.no_reply: The second reader stays built and unrun; the records that fail a machine check are read by one model and Jev's sittings, whose verdicts files carry each college's next fix.

answer.words: Later, on Open Asks Sheet 98 card 2: "I need to get a new subscription first which will take a few days, so keep this on ice for now."

calls.title: Ask Program Mapper's vendor to share the 63 community colleges' program maps
calls.text: Sam pasted the vendor's member list on 2026-10-21; 37 map hosts are now on the registry (#2330). Every mapper host the reader has reached answers 403, so the maps are known and unread. A request to the vendor is outward, so it waits on Sam.
calls.if_no_reply: The maps stay unread; the reader asks each recorded host once a run whether it has opened.

notes.addenda: The eight addenda amending loaded colleges' catalogs were read on Oct 14 and filed on Oct 14 as read, each with the programs and courses it changes. The other 71 listed addenda wait for the reader to reach their colleges.

changes.text: CPL Pathways reads its record list six pages at a time after the first, about 3 seconds instead of 10, and its Pathway list can be cleared.
CPL Pathways gained a search box after the college, an alphabetical Pathway list, and a My College section for the chosen college.
My College left the side menu; a college picked after a search redraws the matches for that college.

Palo Verde reads its new 2026-2027 catalog (66 of 68 programs found, from 54) and Cypress 274 of 282 (from 260); both extractions are running. Mt. San Jacinto's remaining gaps, Ohlone's low-coverage programs and Hartnell's 31 unprinted programs are the catalogs' own.
